articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually drops AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets on public GitHub like some kind of digital exhibitionist. When the cybersecurity watchdog becomes the cybersecurity whoopsie-daisy.

articles.title: The Alert Firehose Finally Meets Its Match
articles.summary: Ghost CMS gets haunted by CVE-2026-26980, a critical SQL injection flaw that let attackers possess 700+ sites for ClickFix campaigns. Even the dead can't escape bad input validation.

articles.title: Ghost CMS CVE-2026-26980 Exploited to Hijack 700+ Sites for ClickFix Attacks
articles.summary: Trump Mobile website leaked thousands of customer records to anyone with basic HTTP skills. MAGA meets OWASP Top 10 in the most predictable crossover episode ever.

articles.title: npm Adds 2FA-Gated Publishing and Package Install Controls Against Supply Chain Attacks
articles.summary: TrapDoor campaign poisoned 34+ packages across npm, PyPI, and Crates.io to steal credentials in a coordinated supply chain nightmare. When your dependency hell becomes actual hell.

articles.title: Security Affairs newsletter Round 578 by Pierluigi Paganini – INTERNATIONAL EDITION
articles.summary: TeamPCP gang poisoned open source at unprecedented scale, hitting GitHub and hundreds of orgs via supply chain attacks. The trust-based ecosystem meets trust-no-one reality.

articles.title: The Dark Side of AI
articles.summary: Anthropic's Project Glasswing AI discovered 10,000+ vulnerabilities faster than humans can patch them. We're officially in the 'AI finds bugs faster than we fix them' dystopia timeline.

articles.title: AI Agents Are Shifting Identity Security Budget Dynamics
articles.summary: Google API keys stay active for 23 minutes after 'deletion' despite claiming immediate removal. Schrödinger's API key: simultaneously deleted and not deleted until observed by security researchers.

articles.title: Akamai Joins Growing Chorus of Vendors Betting Big on Secure Enterprise Browsers
articles.summary: EFF drops new guide to fight back against normalized digital surveillance abuses plaguing the Americas. Because apparently we need instructions on why constant government spying is bad.

articles.title: Microsoft Took a Step Toward Human Rights Accountability. Google and Amazon (and Others) Should Pay Attention!
articles.summary: EFF celebrates a rare win for end-to-end encryption, that magical technology that keeps our digital conversations from becoming government reading material. Privacy wins are like unicorns these days.

articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: Congress demands answers after CISA contractor leaked AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets on public GitHub. The people protecting our cyber-infrastructure can't protect their own repositories.
